traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Surianaceae: leaves alternate; leaves usually simple, rarely compound; margins entire; veins single or pinnate; blades lanceolate, oblanceolate or oblong; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup present or absent; stems woody; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit nut or aggregate; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5 to 10; carpels 1 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
